podcast.body: Released in October 2009, this debut album featured the single "Little Lion Man." The significant success of Mumford & Sons with this album laid the groundwork for a wave of acoustic-based or acoustic-tinged alt-rock in the subsequent decade. "The first single from their debut album, Sino More, which was released in October 2009."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: Released on October 2nd, 2009, this album was recorded at Eastcoat Studios with producer Marcus Draves. The title is derived from a song performed by Balthazar in Shakespeare's *Much Ado About Nothing*. The album incorporates themes and references from Shakespeare (including direct lines from the 1623 text), the Bible, Homer's *The Odyssey*, a biography of St. Francis of Assisi, the teachings of Socrates, and John Steinbeck's *The Grapes of Wrath* and *East of Eden*. It became a massive hit, selling over a million copies in the UK, more than 2 million in the US, and approximately 200,000 copies in Canada where it reached number two on the charts. Worldwide sales exceeded 6 million. "Sinomore was released on October 2nd, 2009."
